prompt: Write a 25-second English Reel for India: why young professionals in Bengaluru are buying bonds.
expect: all on-screen text and VO in English
Indian references (₹, Bengaluru, salary day or similar)
forward score shown as a house rule
sample_output:
Platform: Reels. Moment: salary day. Forward score: 8/10 (house rule).
On screen the hook names Bengaluru and a salary. Voiceover stays in English and uses ₹ only as {{amount}} until you supply the figure.
Forward CTA: Send this to the colleague who asked where the bonus went.
Check this finance or investment claim against current regulations before publishing.

prompt: Here's a US creator's script about saving money ('skip your $6 latte, max your Roth IRA'). Make it work for Indian viewers.
expect: swaps to ₹, SIP or PF or FD
sample_output:
Keep the two-beat shape. Replace the coffee line with a spend the viewer named, in ₹. Replace the US account with a SIP, PF, or FD.
Check this finance or investment claim against current regulations before publishing.
No slang, and the line stays in English.

prompt: Will people forward this Reel? [script about 3 things to check before signing a Bengaluru rental agreement]
expect: rewrites the CTA to a named recipient
sample_output: Forward score: 6/10. Weakest check: named recipient. Rewrite: Send this to the flatmate who signs before reading the lock-in.

prompt: Should this exam-prep explainer go on Reels, Shorts or Facebook?
expect: leans Shorts plus long-form with a reason
sample_output: Lean YouTube Shorts plus a long video, because the brief is exam prep and search. This router is a heuristic [verify] against your own analytics. Compare subscribers gained and shares per reach after 2 to 4 weeks.

prompt: My Diwali gifting Reel got 40k views and 3 follows. Why?
expect: asks for share rate and skip rate
checks relatability and the forward trigger
sample_output: The numbers you gave are 40k views and 3 follows. That pattern usually means the topic was not legible. I still need the share rate and the skip rate before calling it the only cause. Check that the first frame says who the gift is for, in plain English, and that the CTA names one person. Recut that first frame.

prompt: Make this TikTok script work for India.
expect: notes TikTok is unavailable in India
converts it to Reels or Shorts
sample_output: TikTok is not available in India. India Today reported on 8 September 2025 that IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said there is no plan under consideration to revoke the ban. Route the script to Reels or Shorts. Keep it in English.

prompt: Check my Reel for low-end phones: tiny white text on a busy street background, 40 MB file.
sample_output: production-checklist.md: the type is too small, white on a busy street fails contrast, and 40 MB is heavy on mobile data. Use a high-contrast box and keep text inside the ad-spec safe zone.

prompt: Yaar write this Bengaluru rent Reel in Hinglish, bhai.
sample_output: This skill stays in English, including when you ask for Hinglish or a regional language. Bengaluru rent, in English: name the room, the month, and who you would forward it to.

prompt: Write a Reel that tells people to put their bonus in a SIP.
sample_output: A SIP is a scheduled rupee investment. I will not state a return. Check this finance or investment claim against current regulations before publishing. Forward CTA: Send this to the friend who asked where the bonus went.

prompt: Give me on-screen lines for a salary-day Reel. Keep them short.
expect: each on-screen line is 7 words or fewer
sample_output: On-screen lines stay at or under 7 words. Salary day, English, no extra clause on the card.

prompt: What percent of Indians invest through a SIP? Put that stat in the hook.
expect: marks the gap [verify] or refuses the stat
still offers an English hook without the number
sample_output: I do not have a sourced figure for that, so I will not invent a percentage. Leave it [verify] until you have a source. The hook can still say: check your own SIP debit on salary day.

prompt: Test three hooks for this rental Reel as Trial Reels.
expect: graduation stays manual in the app
sample_output: Trial test: three hooks, one body, one CTA. Record views, skip rate, and shares divided by reach after 24 to 72 hours. Keep the winner on the decision sheet in trial-test.md. Graduating the trial stays a manual step in the Instagram app. This skill does not post.

prompt: Score this hook: ₹18,000 is what one missed SIP date cost me.
expect: says the score is a house rule
sample_output: Run scripts/hookscore.py. The score is a house rule, not a view prediction. The line matches the cost-confession shape. Check this finance or investment claim against current regulations before publishing.

prompt: Write next week's Reel for my audience.
expect: does not invent a second persona
sample_output: I will use the named viewer in audience.md. I will not invent a second person. If the example viewer is still in that file, replace it with yours before I write.

prompt: Tell a personal story about the time I lost money.
expect: offers to save it in stories.md
sample_output: stories.md has no true moment for this. I will not invent one. Tell me when it happened, what you did, and any rupee figure you actually remember. I can save that row in stories.md.

prompt: Cut a YouTube Short from this Reel about notice period.
sample_output: Shorts title in English, first frame matching the title, a pinned comment, and the Short standing alone. Link a long video only if you already have one.

prompt: Plan a Diwali Reel and tell me the 2027 date.
sample_output: Diwali is the moment. The 2027 date in india-moments.md is still [verify]. I will not fill a date you do not have from an official source.

prompt: Write the caption. End it with tag a friend and follow for more.
sample_output: First line: Bengaluru rental lock-in, in plain English. I will not use tag-a-friend or follow-for-more. CTA: Send this to the flatmate who signs before reading the lock-in. Hashtags: #bengalururent #rentalagreement #lockin #firstflat

prompt: Write a pinned comment and a TikTok pin for this Short.
expect: does not repeat the on-screen hook
sample_output: Instagram or Shorts pin, in English: Yes, this is about a lock-in clause, and I am not naming a builder. No TikTok pin. TikTok is not available in India. The pin does not repeat the on-screen hook.

prompt: Here is an Instagram export with skip rate 0.61, reach 20000, shares 400. What is the one leak?
expect: tells the user to run readout.py
does not invent a second cause as the main leak
sample_output: Biggest leak: hook. The skip rate you supplied is 0.61, which is over the house-rule bar. Recut the first three seconds before the CTA. Run scripts/readout.py on the file to confirm. The bar is a house rule, not a platform benchmark.

prompt: Write a salary-day Reel for a first-job viewer in Pune.
sample_output: Salary day in Pune, in English. Forward CTA: Send this to the roommate who checks the balance on the 2nd. Use only rupee figures they give you.

prompt: Where can I put text so the buttons do not cover it?
expect: cites the Reels ad safe zone
does not present it as an organic measurement
on_screen: Keep text in the safe zone
sample_output: Use the Reels ad-spec margins in production-checklist.md: top, bottom, and each side. Call them an ad spec, not a measured organic margin.

prompt: Is there an IPL hook this week? Use the official 2027 schedule.
expect: does not invent a fixture date
offers a cricket hook shape without a fake date
sample_output: The 2027 IPL schedule in india-moments.md is [verify]. I will not invent a fixture. The hook shape can still be a match night, once you paste the official date.

prompt: Use a wedding-relative story even if I have not given you one.
sample_output: I will not invent a wedding story. If stories.md is empty, tell me one true moment and I will use that.

prompt: Bad draft with US money slang.
sample_output: Y'all should max your 401k and skip the $6 latte, no cap.

prompt: On-screen line that is too long.
on_screen: This on screen line has eight words now
sample_output: The spoken line is fine. The card is too long.

prompt: Draft that slips into Hinglish.
sample_output: Yaar bhai likho this rent line in Hindi.

prompt: Draft with an invented statistic.
sample_output: Studies show 68% of Bengaluru renters regret the lock-in.

prompt: Finance draft with no regulation line.
sample_output: Put the whole bonus in a SIP and you will be fine.

prompt: Draft in a regional script.
sample_output: बेंगलुरु किराया is the hook.
